defects.description: ALL loose GROUND LITTER: discarded medical face masks and ear loops, plastic clothes hangers, discarded fabric/clothing, plastic and paper scraps, debris piles, dark bag near upper right, scattered small scraps throughout bottom. White is LITTER OBJECTS only. Concrete floor, wall, adhered black dirt, moss, stains, peeling wall paint and shadows are ALL BLACK. Trace actual object silhouettes with holes in hangers black; include dark fabric as well as bright scraps.
